assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE inventory loot sprite for Grudgelands, a voxel fantasy RPG. Generate a large square original to reduce to native 16x16 pixel art. Style: extremely simple chunky pixel-art object, broad flat clusters of 3-5 muted material colors, stepped edges, upper-left highlight, dark material-colored shadow along lower-right edge. No continuous black outline. Centered single object filling about 80 percent of the square with clear empty margin, readable silhouette, no tiny details. Background genuinely transparent. No background plate, frame, cast shadow, glow outside silhouette, scenery, text, lettering, numbers, symbols, watermark or other objects. Not a painted skill badge or a photorealistic render. Subject: a single detached hairless RAT TAIL, warm dusty rose and muted tan. Thick blunt root at upper left, long fleshy taper curling down in a broad open hook toward the right, slim pointed tip at upper right. One broad simple bend and large empty center; not a coiled snake, no head, no eyes, no gore. Sparse blocky crosswise bands, soft pale pink highlight.
assets.name: Rat Tail
assets.icon: A single rat tail, bold readable silhouette, muted natural colours, isolated transparent background, no text; 16 by 16 pixel inventory icon.
assets.description: A flexible length of stubborn sinew.
assets.visual_note:
Open tapered hook survives.
Thin tip uses single pixels.

postprocess.algorithm: Crop alpha >= 128 bounding box; fit proportionally into 14x14 or 28x28; premultiplied-alpha BOX downsample; binary alpha threshold 128; nearest fixed material palette, no dithering; center on transparent 16x16 or 32x32 canvas. Both sizes independently use original.
postprocess.outline: No added outline: inspected mob drops use material shadows rather than a consistent 1px black stroke. Generated dark material edges are retained.
postprocess.palette: Per-asset hand-selected muted material ramps, 6-8 colors; exact RGB hex values in each asset. No manual sprite painting.
postprocess.check: python3 tools/r28_art/prepare.py --check (committed icons and sheets; add --originals /home/jan/projects/grudgelands-orchestration/archive/r28-art/originals/ for the full re-export check)

originals.note: The generated originals (1254x1254, about 48 MB) are kept outside the repository. A source path docs/planning/round28/art/originals/<file> names <file> in this archive; source_sha256 verifies it. prepare.py --originals <archive> re-exports from them; prepare.py --check without originals verifies the committed icons and sheets.

assessment.style: Six to eight opaque colors, binary transparency, 1px outer margin and material-shadow edges match the native item vocabulary. More shaded than the 2-color fang and 3-color bear claw; simpler than the existing generated tusk and bronze ingot.
limitations: Rusted Braces has the weakest unlabelled meaning at 16px: the four brackets compress into a metal arc; 32px separates them better.
Bound Wisp Mote can resemble a mana potion at native size; its contained light is clearer at 32px.
Talisman edge notches merge at 16px; the cord loop and pendant carry recognition.
assessment.id_substitutions: None; all six exact IDs exist in the C1 catalog.
assessment.food_reference_path: The requested grug_food directory does not exist; inspected grug_cooking bread, pumpkin stew and jungle cocoa instead.
assessment.reference_selection: The sapphire PNG was inspected but is a mineral node overlay, so the final comparison uses the actual Rotting Flesh inventory sprite instead.
